issues.where: crop L (1368,0,456,433), sky immediately left of the Moon (also haloing the Moon in image-03.png crop M)
issues.what: a distinct ~120px dark circular patch sits in the sky background to the left of the Moon where green-channel sky glow drops by more than half, exposing an offset matte or leftover Moon cutout on the sky plate
issues.fix: composite the Moon over a clean, unmasked starfield and nebula background with no baked circular cutout or dark halo

issues.where: crops A, E, F, G, and H across the Earth globe (and image-07.png crops J, K, P; image-08.png crop U)
issues.what: at native size the closer Earth view is visibly soft and under-resolved (~35% sharpness loss vs image-02.png): South American city lights smear into blurry 4-6px blobs, coastlines and Arctic islands blur, and clouds near the western limb in crop F show blocky texels and flat baked-on stretching without relief
issues.fix: use higher-resolution Earth albedo, night-lights, and separate cloud maps (16K-32K or tiled detail) so terrain, city lights, and foreshortened clouds stay crisp throughout the camera push-in

issues.where: crops C, H, and I on the dark side of the globe, and upper-right limb in image-06.png crop C
issues.what: airbrushed neon-green streaks are painted directly onto the flat Earth surface texture at mid- and low-latitudes (over the mid-Atlantic, the West African coast in crop I, and the South Atlantic off Brazil in crop H), while the external green aurora rays in image-06.png crop C stop in a hard seam along the geometric sphere silhouette
issues.fix: remove baked green paint from the surface texture and render the aurora as an elevated 3D volumetric shell confined to the polar oval so it wraps continuously across the limb

issues.where: crop M Moon disk and sunlit left limb (and enlarged Moon across image-07.png crops L and M)
issues.what: the lunar surface texture is soft and blocky at native pixel scale, and the bright sunlit left limb has visible stair-stepped pixel aliasing
issues.fix: apply a higher-resolution lunar texture map and render the Moon silhouette with supersampled or multisampled anti-aliasing

issues.where: Arctic cap in crop G (and image-06.png crop G) and Southern Ocean near bottom limb in crop H / image-04.png crop V
issues.what: polar ice and cloud detail smear into a featureless pinched cap toward the North Pole, and ocean/cloud texture stretches tangentially into blurred bands south of Tierra del Fuego
issues.fix: use cube-map or polar-corrected UV mapping with high-latitude detail textures to eliminate equirectangular pole pinching and tangential smearing

issues.where: crop Q dark eastern limb against the Milky Way, and Milky Way background in image-02.png crop I
issues.what: the dark limb carries a faint stepped green-teal rim against the starfield, and faint Milky Way dust clouds show mild blocky color noise behind crisp 1-2px procedural stars
issues.fix: anti-alias and feather the night-side atmospheric rim optical depth and use an uncompressed, higher-bit-depth nebula map matching the star sharpness

issues.where: tiles A, F, G and H: Andes, Central American spine, Rockies, Sierra Madre and Baja
issues.what: ridges are bump-mapped and beveled, so the land reads as a raised relief globe rather than a planet at this scale
issues.fix: flatten the displacement to orbital scale and keep only broad, soft shading

issues.where: lower-left tile V, night side of South America; same streaking in image-14.png tiles E and H
issues.what: city lights, coasts and cloud bands are smeared on a diagonal while the stars in the same crops stay sharp
issues.fix: remove the directional blur on the planet layer, or match it on the starfield if the blur is meant to be exposure motion

issues.where: tile A, Caribbean, Bahamas, Gulf of Mexico and Central American coasts
issues.what: shallow water is a flat saturated cyan shelf with a hard edge against deep ocean
issues.fix: replace the color mask with a gradual depth gradient and break up the shelf color

issues.where: gibbous moon in the mid-left crop, also upper right of image-13.png
issues.what: the lunar surface is softer and lower-detail than the pinpoint stars beside it
issues.fix: raise crater and mare detail so the disk holds up at the same scale as the starfield
